scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Occidental College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (separate PDFs per section; this data from sections B, C, G, H, I)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class, CDS C1: 7,490 applied, 3,359 admitted, 437 enrolled (436 full-time + 1 part-time); the in-state (California), out-of-state and international rows add up to the applicant and admit totals. International first-years: 1,542 applied, 249 admitted, 25 enrolled (C1). Early Decision figures (C21) cover Early Decision only: 412 applications, 177 admitted, 158 enrolled; the CDS also lists a non-restrictive Early Action plan but gives no Early Action counts. SAT/ACT are optional: 25% (108 students) of the entering class submitted the SAT and 8% (36) the ACT. GPA: the CDS gives a 3.64 average (median 3.68, 25th-75th percentile 3.47-3.87) for the 97% of the class that reported a GPA; the distribution shown is the 'all enrolled students' column. Undergraduate enrollment (1,822) and the international count (85) are the B1/B2 'total undergraduates' figures (international = nonresidents, degree- and non-degree-seeking).

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set G1/G5: tuition $70,492, required fees $611, on-campus food and housing $21,022 (double occupancy, maximum meal plan); estimated books $1,290 and personal expenses $1,950 (travel is 'varies' on the college's cost page, so it is not included). The total of $95,365 is the 'Total Estimated Cost of Attendance' printed on oxy.edu/financial-aid/cost for on-campus students (before financial aid). Student health insurance (OSHIP, $4,062 for 2026-27 per that page) is required for non-U.S. citizens and is shown as the extra international fee. CDS H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 51 degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $36,111, total $1,841,686, aid year 2025-26 as marked on the CDS).
